'''Neil Orr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
At some point after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Orr and a team of Rebel agents were [[Mission to Tazan|dispatched]] by the Alliance to the planet [[Tazan]], to destroy an [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] that was located on the world. After arriving on Tazan, Orr and the rest of the team rendezvoused with the Alliance sympathizer [[Willer Clines]] in [[Willer Clines' House|Clines' house]], in the [[Desander Section]] of [[Tazan City]]. However, their conversation with Clines was secretly monitored by a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and once the stormtroopers believed that Rebels had revealed all that they would about their mission, the stormtroopers entered Clines' lounge and attacked Orr and the rest of the Rebels. The agents escaped and eventually infiltrated the Data Processing Facility, where they extracted some Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] communications protocols and then blew up the structure.<ref name="UCD" />

==Personality and traits==
Orr was a keen [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], but unlike some of his colleagues, he held the opinion that an ordinary [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] could perform just as well as an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and would probably be more effective in combat. Orr joined the Alliance primarily because the Alliance imposed less discipline onto their [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] than the Galactic Empire did, rather for political reasons. However, Orr was convinced that the Alliance was the best hope for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and while he wished to be a hero, he was satisfied that he was helping the Alliance to achieve its goals.<ref name="UCD" />
